title: Ginkgo Therapeutics — privacy & edge deployment call notes
content:
Context: 2025-11-03 30m sync with Ginkgo Therapeutics (platform + security + infra). Customer building an on-site inference gateway for clinical decision support; cannot allow any model weights or unredacted PHI to leave their network. They want Redwood Private in a VPC/airlocked mode, maybe an on-prem bundle later.

Attendees: Alicia (Ginkgo platform), Mark (Ginkgo security), Dr. Kayla (ML lead), Sophia Chen (Redwood SE), Ravi P. (Redwood infra), Elena G. (Redwood PM)

High-level asks (customer):
- Fully air-gapped deployment option: no outbound internet from inference hosts except to internal update proxy under Ginkgo control.
- KMS/HSM integration: keys must be in their HSM (Thales) and Redwood should support envelope encryption (we cannot bring keys).
- SAML/Okta SSO + strict RBAC (per-clinical-team) + audit trail integration to their Splunk SIEM.
- Model artifacts: they will bring custom fine-tuned models (PyTorch) but need Redwood runtime compatibility and a recommended quantization pipeline we can run in-house.
- Latency SLA: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 420ms for short clinical prompts (avg 80 tokens); must support occasional burst to 500 req/s.
- Deterministic logging: redaction hooks on user prompt/response streams to strip PHI before logs leave the airlock.

Notes / gotchas: 
- "No weights can leave" constraint means we cannot host model catalog for them; need to support local model onboarding UX (tarball import, checksum verification).
- Their HSM only supports PKCS#11; Redwood already has a PKCS#11 adapter in branch feature/hsm-pkcs11 but needs a compliance review and testing matrix.
- Network: strict egress rules. They allow a management lane to Redwood CP over a customer-controlled proxy during setup only. Need explicit runbook for offline upgrades.
- GPU selection: Dr. Kayla prefers H100 for throughput but budget leans toward mixed A100 + 80GB nodes. Need to produce perf estimates for both.
- Model sizes: they expect to run a custom 7B family and occasional 30B for ensemble scoring. Quantization to int8 or 4-bit recommended; check memory for 30B with KV cache.
- Monitoring: must ship metrics/events into a local Prometheus/Grafana stack; no SaaS telemetry. We have a local-forwarder option but node agents must be hardened.
- Rollback/fallback: they require a fail-closed model — if private nodes degraded, traffic must not leak to hosted fallbacks. We must ensure policy enforces no outbound fallback.

Integration checklist (initial):
- [ ] Confirm PKCS#11 compatibility: run adapter smoke test (owner: Ravi, target: 2025-11-10)
- [ ] Create model-import accept package + checksum validator + docs (owner: Sophia, target: 2025-11-14)
- [ ] Perf sweep for 7B (A100 vs H100) using their prompt set (owner: Dr. Kayla + Redwood bench, target: 2025-11-21)
- [ ] Offline upgrade runbook + rollback plan (owner: Elena, target: 2025-11-17)
- [ ] Logging/redaction hooks prototype: a pre-log filter that runs local regex rules & manual redaction API (owner: Sophia/Ravi, spike by 2025-11-12)
- [ ] SIEM forwarding: ensure Splunk HEC compatibility, TLS pinning (owner: Ravi, target: 2025-11-18)

Open questions (to resolve in next sync):
1) Can Ginkgo accept repository-style model bundles (OCI artifacts) staged on an on-prem registry? If yes, we can use image-based model loading.
2) Exact HSM provisioning process: will they create wrapping keys for us or do we need to support key import flows?
3) Burst capacity: do they want Redwood to provision on-site extra nodes for bursts or expect throttling? Cost model TBD.
4) Are there any regulatory logs retention windows we must enforce (HIPAA: 6 years in some workflows)? Confirm with security.

Immediate next steps (this week):
- Share PKCS#11 adapter doc + minimal test harness (Ravi) — link to repo in Slack.
- Sophia to draft model-import UX flow (zip -> checksum -> register) and sample CLI commands for their infra team.
- Schedule 90m perf lab with Dr. Kayla (we need their sample prompts + 3 representative clinical templates).
- Elena to start draft contract clause around offline upgrades and no-fallback guarantee.

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep language 'no external fallback' explicit in both product config and contract. This is sticky — ops + legal must sync.
- Avoid using hosted analytics for this customer; propose local-only observability. Might be a sales trade (pricing + maintenance).
- Add a small demo showing quantized 7B latency differences to convince them H100 not strictly necessary for small prompt SLOs.

References & links I should attach before next meeting:
- internal: feature/hsm-pkcs11 branch, private-deploy/offline-upgrade-runbook draft, quant-sweep-2025 notebook
- external: example OCI registry flow doc, Splunk HEC TLS pinning guide

End of notes. TODO: circulate to collaborators, ask Mark to confirm retention window and proxy upgrade policy.
